name: rudeness-checker-webapp
description: The single-page app a signed-in User opens to check a sentence: a form to submit a sentence, and a result view showing the agent's yes/no verdict, with a clear path to check another sentence. Holds no history of past checks — each check is a one-off, mirroring the product's stateless design. Does not itself judge rudeness; it only calls the agent and renders what it returns.

dependencies.name: rudeness-checker-agent
dependencies.description: Sends the submitted sentence to the agent and shows the returned rudeness verdict.
